proposed_requirement.record_markdown:
### LE-999: Owner-facing proactive status updates
- Status: live
- Coverage: e2e/journey

After the coordinating assistant observes a meaningful development in active software-change work, it must post a concise source-backed update in the active owner conversation before its next wait, inspect, or help decision. Unchanged observations must not produce a repetitive heartbeat. Machine notifications alone do not satisfy this obligation.
